quests.instruction: Select the antonym for the given word.
quests.hint: Look for a word meaning of a stringed instrument.
quests.explanation: Bowed means of a stringed instrument — the reverse idea is of a stringed instrument, which is what plucked means.

quests.instruction: Find the word with the opposite meaning.
quests.hint: What word fits the idea of being dangerous to health?
quests.explanation: Benign means not dangerous to health, so its opposite, malignant, means dangerous to health.

quests.instruction: Choose the word that means the opposite.
quests.hint: The opposite action here is to move into the foreground to make more visible or prominent.
quests.explanation: Background means understate the importance or quality of — the reverse idea is move into the foreground to make more visible or prominent, which is what foreground means.

quests.instruction: Which option contrasts most directly with the given word?
quests.hint: The opposite idea here is having a dark or somber color.
quests.explanation: Lightness means having a light color; darkness means having a dark or somber color.

quests.instruction: Select the best antonym for the word shown.
quests.hint: Try to recall a word that means to flow back or recede.
quests.explanation: While tide means rise or move forward, ebb means the opposite: flow back or recede.

quests.instruction: Find the word that expresses the reverse idea.
quests.hint: Consider a word that means to give off, send forth, or discharge.
quests.explanation: Absorb refers to suck or take up or in. Emit, by contrast, means give off, send forth, or discharge.

quests.instruction: Choose the option that means the opposite of the given word.
quests.hint: Picture something described as not straightforward, taking a roundabout path or approach.
quests.explanation: Direct means going straight to a point without detours; indirect means not straightforward, taking a roundabout path or approach.

quests.instruction: Which word below is the true opposite?
quests.hint: Try to recall a word that means to come to be detached.
quests.explanation: Attach means become attached, so its opposite, detach, means come to be detached.

quests.instruction: Pick the word that contrasts with the meaning shown.
quests.hint: Consider a word that means to find or declare guilty.
quests.explanation: To acquit means to pronounce not guilty of criminal charges. To convict means the opposite: to find or declare guilty.

quests.instruction: Identify the antonym among the options.
quests.hint: Look for a word meaning lacking or not affording physical or mental rest.
quests.explanation: While restful means affording physical or mental rest, restless means the opposite: lacking or not affording physical or mental rest.

quests.instruction: Select the antonym for the given word.
quests.hint: Think about a word meaning the quality of being unclear or abstruse and hard to understand.
quests.explanation: Clarity means free from obscurity and easy to understand, so its opposite, obscurity, means the quality of being unclear or abstruse and hard to understand.

quests.instruction: Find the word with the opposite meaning.
quests.hint: The opposite action here is to cause to feel better.
quests.explanation: To irritate means to excite to an abnormal condition, or chafe or inflame. To soothe means the opposite: to cause to feel better.

quests.instruction: Choose the word that means the opposite.
quests.hint: The opposite idea here relates to being minor or casual or subordinate in significance or nature or occurring as a chance concomitant or consequence.
quests.explanation: To be basic is to be pertaining to or constituting a base or basis. Incidental means minor or casual or subordinate in significance or nature or occurring as a chance concomitant or consequence, the reverse quality.

quests.instruction: Which option contrasts most directly with the given word?
quests.hint: Search for a word meaning to put out, as of fires, flames, or lights.
quests.explanation: Ignite means cause to start burning — the reverse idea is put out, as of fires, flames, or lights, which is what extinguish means.

quests.instruction: Select the best antonym for the word shown.
quests.hint: This word describes something that is including much or everything.
quests.explanation: Exclusive refers to excluding much or all. Inclusive, by contrast, means including much or everything.

quests.instruction: Find the word that expresses the reverse idea.
quests.hint: Think about a word meaning characteristic of a mother.
quests.explanation: To be paternal is to be characteristic of a father. Maternal means characteristic of a mother, the reverse quality.

quests.instruction: Choose the option that means the opposite of the given word.
quests.hint: The opposite idea here is all the plant life in a particular region or period.
quests.explanation: Fauna refers to all the animal life in a particular region or period. Flora, by contrast, means all the plant life in a particular region or period.

quests.instruction: Which word below is the true opposite?
quests.hint: What word means to grant relief or an exemption from a rule or requirement to?
quests.explanation: Enforce means ensure observance of laws and rules — the reverse idea is grant relief or an exemption from a rule or requirement to, which is what exempt means.

quests.instruction: Pick the word that contrasts with the meaning shown.
quests.hint: Imagine describing something as being or situated at an end.
quests.explanation: Intermediate means lying between two extremes in time or space or state — the reverse idea is being or situated at an end, which is what terminal means.

quests.instruction: Identify the antonym among the options.
quests.hint: Try to recall a word that means the combination of ideas into a complex whole.
quests.explanation: While analysis means the abstract separation of a whole into its constituent parts in order to study the parts and their relations, synthesis means the opposite: the combination of ideas into a complex whole.

quests.instruction: Select the antonym for the given word.
quests.hint: This word means to cause to be alert and energetic.
quests.explanation: While sedate means cause to be calm or quiet as by administering a sedative to, stimulate means the opposite: cause to be alert and energetic.

quests.instruction: Find the word with the opposite meaning.
quests.hint: Think about a word meaning free from blood or bloodshed.
quests.explanation: Bloody refers to having or covered with or accompanied by blood. Bloodless, by contrast, means free from blood or bloodshed.

quests.instruction: Choose the word that means the opposite.
quests.hint: What word fits the idea of being depriving of confidence or hope or enthusiasm and hence often deterring action?
quests.explanation: Encouraging means giving courage or confidence or hope, so its opposite, discouraging, means depriving of confidence or hope or enthusiasm and hence often deterring action.

quests.instruction: Which option contrasts most directly with the given word?
quests.hint: Consider a word that means to burst outward, usually with noise.
quests.explanation: Implode means to burst inward; explode means to burst outward, usually with noise.

quests.instruction: Select the best antonym for the word shown.
quests.hint: Imagine describing something as lacking the rights and advantages of other members of society.
quests.explanation: Privileged refers to blessed with privileges. Underprivileged, by contrast, means lacking the rights and advantages of other members of society.

quests.instruction: Find the word that expresses the reverse idea.
quests.hint: Try to recall a word that means to make too high an estimate of.
quests.explanation: Underestimate means make too low an estimate of — the reverse idea is make too high an estimate of, which is what overestimate means.

quests.instruction: Choose the option that means the opposite of the given word.
quests.hint: Try to recall a word that means to make more complicated.
quests.explanation: While simplify means make simpler or easier or reduce in complexity or extent, complicate means the opposite: make more complicated.

quests.instruction: Which word below is the true opposite?
quests.hint: Look for a word meaning with little or no sound.
quests.explanation: Noisily means with much noise or loud and unpleasant sound, so its opposite, quietly, means with little or no sound.

quests.instruction: Pick the word that contrasts with the meaning shown.
quests.hint: Consider a word that means to choose not to consume.
quests.explanation: While consume means serve oneself to, or consume regularly, abstain means the opposite: choose not to consume.

quests.instruction: Identify the antonym among the options.
quests.hint: The opposite idea here relates to being characteristic of the provinces or their people.
quests.explanation: Cosmopolitan refers to composed of people from or at home in many parts of the world. Provincial, by contrast, means characteristic of the provinces or their people.
